title: Central Team Visits Flood-Hit Arunachal Village to Assess Damage
summary: A central team has visited the flood-hit village of Keyi Panyor in Arunachal Pradesh to assess the damage and provide aid. The visit comes after severe flooding hit the region, displacing residents and causing widespread destruction. The government's response to the disaster is being closely watched by locals and experts alike.
summary_points: A central team has visited Keyi Panyor village in Arunachal Pradesh
The visit aims to assess damage and provide aid to affected residents
Severe flooding hit the region, displacing residents and causing destruction
The government's response to the disaster is being closely monitored
Locals and experts are watching the government's actions with interest

summary_hi: केंद्रीय टीम ने अरुणाचल की पानी भरी हुई जगह पर जाकर नुकसान का मूल्यांकन किया, जिससे प्रभावित निवासियों को मदद की जा सके। इस दौरान, भारी बाढ़ ने क्षेत्र को प्रभावित कर दिया, जिसमें लोगों को अपने घरों से बाहर निकाला गया और व्यापक नुकसान हुआ।
summary_points_hi: केंद्रीय टीम ने अरुणाचल की पानी भरी हुई जगह पर जाकर मूल्यांकन किया
इस दौरान, प्रभावित निवासियों को मदद की जा सकेगी

प्रभावित लोगों और विशेषज्ञों द्वारा सरकार की कार्रवाई पर ध्यान दिया जा रहा है

center: Centrist coverage frames the story as a humanitarian crisis, focusing on the immediate needs of affected residents and the central team's assessment of damage. They also touch upon the government's response to the disaster.
